papers.title: Multiobjective Optimal Control Methods for Fluid Flow Using Reduced Order Modeling
papers.abstract: In a wide range of applications it is desirable to optimally control a dynamical system with respect to concurrent, potentially competing goals. This gives rise to a multiobjective optimal control problem where, instead of computing a single optimal solution, the set of optimal compromises, the so-called Pareto set, has to be approximated. When the problem under consideration is described by a partial differential equation (PDE), as is the case for fluid flow, the computational cost rapidly increases and makes its direct treatment infeasible. Reduced order modeling is a very popular method to reduce the computational cost, in particular in a multi query context such as uncertainty quantification, parameter estimation or optimization. In this article, we show how to combine reduced order modeling and multiobjective optimal control techniques in order to efficiently solve multiobjective optimal control problems constrained by PDEs. We consider a global, derivative free optimization method as well as a local, gradient based approach for which the optimality system is derived in two different ways. The methods are compared with regard to the solution quality as well as the computational effort and they are illustrated using the example of the two-dimensional incompressible flow around a cylinder.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了结合降阶模型的多目标最优控制方法，可迁移到生物力学植入物设计的PDE约束优化问题。
llm.why_not_core: Does not address implant mechanics, structural FEA, or uncertainty quantification; validated only on fluid dynamics without biomedical context.

summary_zh.motivation: 降低PDE约束的多目标最优控制问题的计算成本
summary_zh.method: 将降阶模型与全局和局部多目标优化方法结合
summary_zh.result: 通过二维圆柱绕流算例验证了方法的效率和解质量
summary_zh.validation: 数值仿真案例（二维不可压缩流）

summary_en.motivation: To reduce the computational burden of solving multiobjective optimal control problems constrained by partial differential equations.
summary_en.method: Combines reduced order modeling with both global derivative-free and local gradient-based multiobjective optimization techniques.
summary_en.result: The proposed method efficiently approximates Pareto sets and is demonstrated on two-dimensional incompressible flow around a cylinder.
summary_en.validation: Numerical simulation case of 2D incompressible flow benchmark problem.

papers.title: Independent Evaluation of a Mechanical Hip Socket Navigation System in Total Hip Arthroplasty

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文评估了全髋关节置换术中的机械导航系统，但未涉及股骨柄植入后的生物力学分析或有限元建模。
llm.why_not_core: No biomechanical modeling, no stress/strain analysis in Gruen zones, no micromotion quantification, no FEA, no implant design or bone-implant interface evaluation.

summary_zh.motivation: 评估机械髋臼导航系统在全髋置换术中的准确性
summary_zh.method: 术中机械导航与传统手持技术对比，测量髋臼杯放置精度
summary_zh.result: 机械导航提高了杯放置的准确性和可重复性
summary_zh.validation: 临床患者数据对比验证

summary_en.motivation: To evaluate the accuracy of a mechanical hip socket navigation system compared to conventional freehand technique in total hip arthroplasty.
summary_en.method: Intraoperative mechanical navigation was used to guide cup placement, and orientation was measured postoperatively.
summary_en.result: The navigation system significantly improved the accuracy and reproducibility of acetabular cup placement.
summary_en.validation: Clinical validation in a cohort of patients undergoing total hip arthroplasty.

papers.title: Postoperative radiograph of the hip arthroplasty: what the radiologist should know
papers.abstract: This pictorial review aims to provide the radiologist with simple and systematic guidelines for the radiographic evaluation of a hip prosthesis. Currently, there is a plethora of commercially available arthroplasties, making postoperative analysis not always straightforward. Knowledge of the different types of hip arthroplasty and fixating techniques is a prerequisite for correct imaging interpretation. After identification of the type of arthroplasty, meticulous and systematic analysis of the following parameters on an anteroposterior standing pelvic radiograph should be undertaken: leg length, vertical and horizontal centre of rotation, lateral acetabular inclination, and femoral stem positioning. Additional orthogonal views may be useful to evaluate acetabular anteversion. Complications can be classified in three major groups: periprosthetic lucencies, sclerosis or bone proliferation, and component failure or fracture. Teaching Points • To give an overview of the different types of currently used hip arthroplasties. • To provide a simple framework for a systematic approach to postoperative radiographs. • To discuss radiographic findings of the most common complications.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文不涉及生物力学建模或有限元分析，专注于术后X线片的解读，与用户的研究方向无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper provides a clinical radiology review of hip prosthesis radiographic evaluation; it does not quantify stress shielding, micromotion, or bone-implant interface mechanics, and contains no computational modeling or experimental validation relevant to hip implant biomechanics.

summary_zh.motivation: 为放射科医生提供髋关节假体术后X线片的系统解读指南。
summary_zh.method: 通过图文综述介绍不同类型髋关节置换术及并发症的影像学表现。
summary_zh.result: 提出一套标准化评估参数（腿长、旋转中心、倾角等）及常见并发症分类。
summary_zh.validation: 无实验验证，为文献综述。

summary_en.motivation: To provide radiologists with a systematic and simple framework for postoperative radiographic evaluation of hip prostheses.
summary_en.method: A pictorial review covering common hip arthroplasty types, fixation techniques, and systematic assessment of key radiographic parameters on anteroposterior pelvic radiographs.
summary_en.result: A framework for identifying periprosthetic lucencies, bone remodeling, component failure, and other complications is described.
summary_en.validation: No experimental or computational validation; this is a clinical review article.
